articles.title: EU proposes $54.7 billion fund for AI, quantum startups alongside post-quantum security push
articles.snippet: Brussels wants tech firms to grow at home. EU scale-ups raise about half the capital of San Francisco peers by year 10, an EIB study found.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs from lows as markets bounce from big early declines
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq narrowed an early 4.5% plunge to just a modest loss, with Michael Burry announcing he's closed all tech shorts and gone long.

articles.title: Solana developers move to stop validators finishing work on blocks that already lost
articles.snippet: The fix would stop the computers that run Solana from wasting effort on transactions the network has already thrown out, freeing up power its recent speed upgrade didn't touch.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
articles.snippet: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.

articles.title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
articles.snippet: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.
